A lace bunny micro set in four pieces: bra, panties, headband and neck ring, in white or black polyester lace. The headband carries the ears and the neck ring closes the look - the two accessories that define the bunny format.

One size covers 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg).

  • Material: polyester lace
  • Includes: bra, panties, headband, neck ring
  • Style: bunny, four-piece
  • Colors: white, black
  • Sizing: one size, 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg)

White gives the bunny look its classic register; black tilts the same four pieces toward the cocktail end of the spectrum. Two colors, no functional difference between them.

Four matched pieces at the single set price - the neck ring alone is the piece that cheaper bundles on this shelf tend to drop first.

The four-piece count is what makes this a set rather than a bra-and-panties pair with packaging: both accessories carry the bunny theme, and neither one is filler.

Simple, recognizable, complete as delivered - the default entry point of the bunny format.
20491.short: Lace bunny micro set, four pieces with headband and neck ring in white or black polyester, one size for 88-132 lbs.
20491.tkd_title: Lace Bunny Micro Set, 4 Pieces | RoseToys
20491.tkd_desc: Polyester lace bunny micro set with bra, panties, headband and neck ring in white or black, one size for 88-132 lbs at RoseToys.

20625.desc:
A backless Christmas sweater in red polyester - one single piece, no accessories in the bundle. The sweater knit gives it the cold-weather hand, while the open back keeps the piece on the lingerie side of the line rather than in loungewear.

One size covers 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg); the knit stretches across the band without pulling at the seams.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: sweater, single piece
  • Style: Christmas, backless
  • Color: red
  • Sizing: one size, 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg)

Red sweater knit is the December default across the board - this version turns it toward the evening with the backless cut. The single-piece format makes it the simplest holiday option on the whole nightwear shelf.

Worn with the pearl strands or the leg-warmers already in the drawer, it holds a full December outfit together without another purchase.

Hand wash cold to keep the knit from pilling over the seasons, and lay each piece flat to dry.
20625.short: Red backless Christmas sweater in polyester knit, single piece with stretch across the band, one size for 88-132 lbs. Cold-weather holiday lingerie.
20625.tkd_desc: Red polyester backless Christmas sweater, single piece knit with stretch, one size for 88-132 lbs. Cold-weather holiday lingerie at RoseToys.

20630.desc:
Tiger stripe on coral fleece: this plush five-piece set covers bra, panties, hat, arm sleeves and leg loops. Coral fleece is the plushest base on this shelf - thicker than standard plush and warmer than any lace in the category.

One size covers 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg).

  • Material: coral fleece
  • Includes: bra, panties, hat, arm sleeves, leg loops
  • Style: tiger stripe, five-piece
  • Sizing: one size, 88-132 lbs (40-60 kg)

Tiger stripe is the louder cat option - where the cat-girl set plays cute, this one plays bold. The hat and sleeves carry the stripe across the whole silhouette.

Of the animal sets in the category, tiger is the one that reads costume-first rather than lingerie-first - the print does that on its own.

Five pieces in one bundle, and the fleece makes it a winter-party set rather than a summer-convention one. Cold wash cycles keep the coral fleece from matting down over time.
20630.short: Coral-fleece plush tiger set in five pieces - bra, panties, hat, sleeves and leg loops, tiger striped, one size for 88-132 lbs.
20630.tkd_title: Plush Tiger Five-Piece Set, Coral Fleece | RoseToys
20630.tkd_desc: Coral-fleece plush tiger set with five pieces, hat, sleeves and leg loops, tiger striped, one size for 88-132 lbs at RoseToys.

22024.desc:
A chain-detail dress with irregular zips in black polyester - a single piece, no separate accessories. The zips run at off angles rather than straight lines, and the chain detailing gives the dress its hardware edge.

One size spans 90-155 lbs - one of the widest single-size bands anywhere on the lingerie shelf.

  • Material: polyester
  • Includes: dress, single piece
  • Style: chain detail, irregular zips
  • Color: black
  • Sizing: one size, 90-155 lbs

The zip placement is the design itself: every closure is a visible detail rather than hidden hardware. Layered over a bodysuit or worn on bare skin, the dress shifts between outerwear and lingerie depending on what sits under it.

Between the chain and the zips, the dress carries enough metal detail to anchor an outfit on its own - no belt or collar needed.

Hand wash cold; the zips and chain hardware want air drying away from direct heat.
22024.short: Black polyester chain-detail dress with irregular zips, single piece cut, one size for 90-155 lbs. Hardware-edge lingerie with visible metal closures.
22024.tkd_desc: Black polyester chain dress with irregular zips, single piece, one size for 90-155 lbs. Hardware-edge lingerie with visible closures.
